name: Antichrist
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against the antichrist, who comes in the name of Christ, claiming to be Him, and deceives many, as emphasized in Matthew 24:5 and Mark 13:6. False Christs and prophets will perform great signs and wonders to lead even the elect astray (Matthew 24:24). Believers are instructed not to believe claims of Christ’s physical presence in specific locations, highlighting the deceitful nature of these imposters (Matthew 24:23-26; Mark 13:21). These passages reveal the persistent spirit of antichrist activity that denies the true incarnation and authority of Jesus Christ.
